dataset.name: WTC 1 V8S aircraft-impact replay freeze and readiness gate
dataset.scope: AA11/WTC 1 aircraft kinematics, aircraft mass distribution, tower geometry, reduced geometric and energy checks, explicit-solver inventory, and predeclared validation metrics. No fire, collapse, explosive, thermite, or Blender rigid-body physics is solved in this iteration.

evidence_policy.official_fact: A directly transcribed value or statement from a NIST source.
evidence_policy.official_model_output: A result produced by the NIST LS-DYNA model; reserved for comparison and never used as a V8S predictor input.
evidence_policy.archive_claim: A claim from the read-only local archive; none is used as a V8S numerical input.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: A declared simplification made by V8S.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic calculation from declared inputs.
evidence_policy.unknown: A required datum or capability that is not established in the local working set.

used_for: core topology and reconstructed metric coordinates
sources.warning: The core identifiers and topology are official, but metric core coordinates are reconstructed to about plus or minus 0.30 m and the facade plate schedule is incomplete.

aircraft_geometry.source: NCSTAR 1-2B v1 Figure 7-6, printed page 164 (PDF page 262)
aircraft_geometry.wingtip_deflection_circularity_warning: The wingtip deflection used by NIST was estimated partly from the observed impact pattern and cannot independently validate that pattern.

aircraft_mass.source: NCSTAR 1-2B v1 Tables 4-3 and 4-4, printed pages 71 and 77 (PDF pages 169 and 175)

video_kinematics.source: NCSTAR 1-2B v1 Table 7-3, printed page 166 (PDF page 264)
video_kinematics.qualification: The speed and velocity-vector ranges are video-analysis products. Table 7-3 lists the AA11 roll value but leaves both fuselage-orientation fields blank.

damage_refined_kinematics.source: NCSTAR 1-2B v1 Tables 7-4 and 7-5, printed page 170 (PDF page 268)
damage_refined_kinematics.circularity_warning: NIST refined aircraft orientation and position by matching projected aircraft component locations to the observed north-facade damage. A replay using these refined values is a reproduction check, not an independent validation of the facade damage pattern.

nist_global_input_cases.source: NCSTAR 1-2B v2 Tables 9-2 and 9-7, printed pages 198 and 257 (PDF pages 16 and 75)

tower_geometry.geometry_status: Facade bay spacing and count are official-level inputs; exact plate thicknesses, welds, bolts, windows, contents, and all local connections in the impact zone are not yet an as-built explicit mesh.

official_outputs_reserved_for_validation.starboard_engine_final_location: about one third of the distance from core to south exterior wall
official_outputs_reserved_for_validation.far_side_statement: The bulk of aircraft debris and fuel was arrested before exiting the far side of the core; a small amount of aircraft debris was calculated to exit the south wall.
official_outputs_reserved_for_validation.outside_tower_ambiguity: The published outside total combines material rebounding from the north impact face and material passing through the south side; it is not a measured far-side-only mass.
official_outputs_reserved_for_validation.base_case_floor_distribution_source: NCSTAR 1-2B v2 Table 9-4, printed page 228 (PDF page 46)
official_outputs_reserved_for_validation.use_rule: These values are loaded only after all V8S input-derived quantities have been calculated. They cannot calibrate mass, speed, geometry, or failure parameters.

validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: erreur absolue du bilan travail externe + énergie interne + énergie cinétique résiduelle, divisée par l’énergie cinétique initiale

validation_metrics_predeclared.target: NIST time at which the aircraft is completely inside the tower
validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: écart absolu entre temps prédit et temps rapporté

validation_metrics_predeclared.target: digitized observed north-facade column and spandrel damage mask
validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: précision, rappel, F1 et intersection-sur-union à la résolution élément-par-étage
validation_metrics_predeclared.gate: F1 supérieur ou égal à 0,80, sans utiliser d’entrée raffinée sur les dommages pour un test indépendant

validation_metrics_predeclared.target: NIST less/base/more-severe core damage tables reserved from input
validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: score de classification pondéré par étage pour les états intact, léger, modéré, lourd et sectionné
validation_metrics_predeclared.gate: macro-F1 supérieur ou égal à 0,70; publier chaque cas séparément

validation_metrics_predeclared.target: NIST Figure 9-6 digitized normalized momentum curve
validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: RMSE sur 0,00-0,70 s et fraction résiduelle à 0,25 s

validation_metrics_predeclared.target: NIST Table 9-4 after correction for explicitly reported eroded mass
validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: distance L1 normalisée et distance de transport sur les étages 92-99 plus l’extérieur
validation_metrics_predeclared.gate: diagnostic seulement tant que l’érosion numérique et les fenêtres ne sont pas harmonisées

validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: masses et trajectoires séparées pour carburant, moteurs, trains d’atterrissage, fragments d’avion et débris de tour
validation_metrics_predeclared.gate: aucune étiquette « avion intact sortant »; tout objet sortant conserve catégorie et provenance

validation_metrics_predeclared.target: observed survival for about 102 min after impact
validation_metrics_predeclared.metric: la structure endommagée à froid reprend les charges gravitaires avant couplage thermique

solver_inventory.name: CalculiX
solver_inventory.role: solveur structurel pour contrôles de composants et quasi-statiques
solver_inventory.reason: The current workflow has no validated CalculiX formulation for coupled high-rate contact, fragmentation/erosion and SPH-like fuel dispersion at the required global scale.

solver_inventory.name: LS-DYNA
solver_inventory.role: solveur explicite non linéaire de référence à grande vitesse

solver_inventory.name: Abaqus Explicit
solver_inventory.role: solveur explicite non linéaire candidat à grande vitesse

solver_inventory.name: OpenRadioss
solver_inventory.role: solveur explicite non linéaire candidat à grande vitesse

model_hypotheses: Tous les composants de l’avion partagent initialement la même vitesse de translation; leur part d’énergie cinétique suit donc leur part de masse.
Le diagnostic réduit de silhouette projette une envergure rigide et non déformée selon le roulis; ce n’est pas un calcul de rupture ni de dommages de façade.
L’estimation du franchissement de la queue projette la longueur du fuselage sur la direction de vitesse et néglige la flexion locale avant impact.
Aucune sortie NIST de dommage, moment, débris ou pénétration ne règle les calculs cinématiques V8S.
required_missing_inputs: licensed or open nonlinear explicit high-rate solver validated for contact, fragmentation and erosion at this scale
solver-ready Boeing 767 material, thickness, joint, failure and fuel model with provenance
as-built WTC 1 facade plate, weld, bolt, window, floor and content mesh for Floors 92-100
independently digitized north-facade observed damage mask reserved from model setup
digitized NIST Figure 9-6 momentum history reserved from calibration
measured object-by-object far-side debris trajectories for WTC 1
computational convergence plan for mesh, time step, contact, erosion and mass scaling
